meta.name: I Think You Should Leave with Tim Robinson
meta.description: There is no such thing as an ordinary interaction in this offbeat sketch comedy series that features a deep roster of guest stars.

videos.title: Has This Ever Happened to You?
videos.overview: An awkward exit at a job interview. A very specific legal problem. Things get ugly at the "Baby of the Year" contest. A gift receipt causes stress.

videos.title: Thanks for Thinking They Are Cool
videos.overview: A nifty new tug-friendly t-shirt. The smart way to ditch your toupee. A prank doesn't go so well. An airline passenger gets aggressively creepy.

videos.title: It's the Cigars You Smoke That Are Gonna Give You Cancer
videos.overview: A magic show opens up a marital rift. Interesting idea at a car design brainstorm. A fill-in organist at a funeral. A very esoteric charades player.

videos.title: Oh Crap, a Bunch More Bad Stuff Just Happened
videos.overview: A service dog gets super friendsly. Ebenezer Scrooge and the Ghost of Christmas Way-Future. A man takes a bumper sticker way too literally.

videos.title: I'm Wearing One of Their Belts Right Now
videos.overview: A hot dog-shaped car crash. A co-worker latches on to an expression. Music studio riffing goes awry. An excuse for tardiness spirals out of control

videos.title: We Used to Watch This at My Old Work
videos.overview: A solution to equine-related emasculation. A problematic game show mascot. Baby shower planning gets heated. A weird place to hold an intervention

videos.title: They said that to me at a dinner.
videos.overview: An unplanned meeting leads to lunchtime chaos. A prank show goes awry at the mall. The "Little Buff Boys" competition. A ghost tour guest goes too far.

videos.title: They have a cake shop there Susan where the cakes just look stunning.
videos.overview: An office dispute over shirt patterns. A little lie about the ice cream store escalates quickly. A man suspects a baby is aware of his checkered past.

videos.title: You sure about that? You sure about that that's why?
videos.overview: A professor really regrets his dinner order. The Carber hot dog vacuum. "Detective Crashmore." A hat has its day in court.

videos.title: Everyone just needs to be more in the moment.
videos.overview: An offhanded joke leaves a husband guilt-ridden. An attempt to ease tensions during a trip backfires. A pants-centric website with a specific purpose.

videos.title: Didn't you say there was gonna be five people at this table?
videos.overview: A novice driver in a parking lot. Defying the rules of credit card roulette. Celebrity impersonators get unruly. Date night at a cosmos-themed bar.

videos.title: I need a wet paper towel.
videos.overview: A mistaken identity at work. The new "Tammy Craps" doll. Some interesting instructional videos during a Driver's Ed class and an attempted ear-piercing.

videos.title: THAT WAS THE EARTH TELLING ME I'M SUPPOSED TO DO SOMETHING GREAT.
videos.overview: A TV pundit copes with conflict. Team building breaks down. Is Ronnie here for the right reasons? A dad tries to look tough. James asks for a ride home.

videos.title: I CAN DO WHATEVER I WANT.
videos.overview: A VR shopping spree takes a turn. Consider a high-security dog door! Ponytail problems. A bad egg at the office. Old wounds surface at a sitcom taping.

videos.title: CUT TO: WE'RE CHATTING ABOUT THIS AT YOUR BACHELOR PARTY.
videos.overview: A silent performer builds a hostile fanbase. First date jitters. A doctor monitors a patient's heart. Paying it forward. Catharsis at an office party.

videos.title: SO NOW EVERY TIME I'M ABOUT TO DO SOMETHING I REALLY WANT TO DO, I ASK MYSELF, "WAIT A MINUTE, WHAT IS THIS?"
videos.overview: Stuart's co-workers learn about his friend group. A proposal spot does double duty. Try Gelutol! Goodbye, Ronnie. Matching shirts at a school concert.

videos.title: DON'T JUST SAY "RELAX," ACTUALLY RELAX.
videos.overview: Amanda, do not say Randall is interesting. Father of the bride vs. a wedding photo booth. A new small-talk strategy at a party yields unexpected results.

videos.title: WHEN I FIRST THOUGHT OF THIS YOU DIDN'T EVEN HAVE HANDS UP THERE — YOU WERE JUST WALKING STRAIGHT UP THE WALL.
videos.overview: Banana breath at sensitivity training. Technical issues hit Metal Motto Search. Don Bon Darley loses his touch. What's up with Draven's Tasty Time Vids?
